reviews.reason: The complete 14-capability catalogue has been checked. Gather transfers finite exposed stock; probe can inspect or consume a small test sample but does not establish a planted, persistent growing organism. Neither these nor the other listed functions implements cultivation. Develop a general planting-and-tending operation, initially supporting a real root propagation trial where biologically feasible. Edibility does not establish propagation viability. The observed Meadow roots currently have zero exposed stock, not six available units, and neither that source nor the five owned root units may be renewed by declaration. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: The request, development, waiting, naming and three-round individual study yield no pleasure, satisfaction or mastery reward. No success reward for merely issuing cultivate. Verified personally acquired observations, including informative failure, may use the existing information-gain mechanism only after an actual observable event, functionally deduplicated against probe and prior cultivation observations. Do not create a new reward account if none is implemented. Applicable actors study separately. Initial executable protocol uses one whole unit as treatment and one whole unit of the same resource and comparable existing age/decay as an untreated comparison; maximum initial batch is two food units. If these checks cannot be implemented for available materials, do not consume food or fabricate a rack: return the unmet physical prerequisite and admit the necessary support preparation/contact-safety mechanism into this same development handoff. Treatment and comparison use distinct positions under the same ambient conditions; expose the treatment on a validated raised, ventilated surface and leave the comparison under the existing ordinary ground-storage conditions. Record this difference explicitly; it tests the complete exposure/storage treatment, not drying alone. No perfectly matched environment or scientific certainty is fabricated.

The current packet supplies no drying coefficients, validated safe moisture threshold or complete spoilage model. Any extra action needs a disclosed implemented cost and real material prerequisites.
